metadata.question: Did the land surface in Denmark appear more brown in July 24, 2018 compared to July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did the land surface in Denmark appear more brown in July 24, 2018 compared to July 19, 2017?" Interpretation: "More brown" suggests less vegetation, which can be detected using NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index). Lower NDVI indicates less vegetation (more brown/dry soil). So we need to compare NDVI values between these two dates. Plan: 1. Get geometry for Denmark using FAO GAUL dataset. 2. For each date (2017-07-19 and 2018-07-24), acquire cloud-free imagery. We'll try: - Sentinel-2 first (best resolution, frequent coverage) - If no image on exact date, try ±1 day (3-day window) - If still no image, try Landsat 8 with 3-day window 3. Compute NDVI: - Sentinel-2: (B8 - B4)/(B8 + B4) - Landsat 8: (B5 - B4)/(B5 + B4) 4. Calculate mean NDVI over Denmark for each date. 5. Compare: If 2018 NDVI < 2017 NDVI → more brown in 2018 → Answer A (Yes). Otherwise B (No). 6. Handle edge cases: - C1: No images for one or both dates after trying fallbacks. - C2: Images exist but 0 valid pixels after cloud masking. - C3: Invalid NDVI values (NaN, out of reasonable range >1.5 or <-1.5). - D: Any coding errors (we'll try to avoid). Note: We must output concise evidence (max 20 lines). We'll print: - Date, mean NDVI, valid pixel count, and data source for each date. - The comparison result and final answer tag. Implementation steps: 1. Authenticate and initialize EE. 2. Define Denmark geometry. 3. Define cloud masking functions for Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8. 4. Function to get NDVI image for a given date with fallbacks. 5. Check if we got images for both dates (if not, output C1). 6. Compute mean NDVI and valid pixel count for each date. 7. Check if valid pixel count is 0 (if so, output C2). 8. Check if mean NDVI is valid (not NaN, within reasonable range) (if not, output C3). 9. Compare NDVI values and output A or B. We'll use a scale of 1000m for reduceRegion to avoid timeout. Let's code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry for Denmark var denmark = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Denmark')); var geometry = denmark.geometry(); // 2. Define dates var date2017 = '2017-07-19'; var date2018 = '2018-07-24'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { var qa = image.select('QA60'); var cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; var cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Cloud masking for Landsat 8 function maskL8clouds(image) { var qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); var cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3; var cloudsBitMask = 1 << 5; var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to get NDVI image for a given date with fallbacks async function getNDVI(dateStr) { var date = ee.Date(dateStr); // Try Sentinel-2 exact date var s2_exact = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(date, date.advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(geometry) .map(maskS2clouds); var count = await s2_exact.size().getInfo(); if (count > 0) { var image = s2_exact.median(); var ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return {ndvi: ndvi, source: 'Sentinel-2 (exact)', imageCount: count}; } // Try Sentinel-2 with 3-day window var s2_3day = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(date.advance(-1, 'day'), date.advance(2, 'day')) .filterBounds(geometry) .map(maskS2clouds); count = await s2_3day.size().getInfo(); if (count > 0) { image = s2_3day.median(); ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return {ndvi: ndvi, source: 'Sentinel-2 (3-day)', imageCount: count}; } // Try Landsat 8 with 3-day window var l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(date.advance(-1, 'day'), date.advance(2, 'day')) .filterBounds(geometry) .map(maskL8clouds); count = await l8.size().getInfo(); if (count > 0) { image = l8.median(); ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return {ndvi: ndvi, source: 'Landsat8 (3-day)', imageCount: count}; } return null; // No data } // Get NDVI for both dates var ndvi2017 = await getNDVI(date2017); var ndvi2018 = await getNDVI(date2018); // Check for no data (C1) if (!ndvi2017 || !ndvi2018) { console.log('2017 Images: ' + (ndvi2017 ? ndvi2017.imageCount : 0)); console.log('2018 Images: ' + (ndvi2018 ? ndvi2018.imageCount : 0)); console.log('C1'); return; } // Function to compute stats async function computeStats(ndviImage, label) { var stats = ndviImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return await stats.getInfo(); } // Compute stats var stats2017 = await computeStats(ndvi2017.ndvi, '2017-07-19'); var stats2018 = await computeStats(ndvi2018.ndvi, '2018-07-24'); var mean2017 = stats2017.NDVI_mean; var count2017 = stats2017.NDVI_count; var mean2018 = stats2018.NDVI_mean; var count2018 = stats2018.NDVI_count; // Print evidence (concise) console.log('2017-07-19: NDVI=' + mean2017.toFixed(3) + ', Pixels=' + count2017 + ', Source=' + ndvi2017.source); console.log('2018-07-24: NDVI=' + mean2018.toFixed(3) + ', Pixels=' + count2018 + ', Source=' + ndvi2018.source); // Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid values (C3) if (mean2017 === null || mean2018 === null || isNaN(mean2017) || isNaN(mean2018) || Math.abs(mean2017) > 1.5 || Math.abs(mean2018) > 1.5) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: lower NDVI means more brown if (mean2018 < mean2017) { console.log('2018 NDVI lower -> more brown in 2018.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2018 NDVI not lower -> not more brown in 2018.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
